verdict.rationale: uv exposes a stable, well-documented CLI (docs-1–51, probe-4 confirms an official CLI reference) with some machine-friendly output like `uv version --output-format json` (uv-docs-28) and a claimed llms.txt docs index (uv-docs-52), which let an AI agent drive it via shell commands. However there is no REST/SDK-style public API — probes confirm no OpenAPI spec exists (uv-probe-3) and root llms.txt / markdown-doc paths return 404 (uv-probe-1, uv-probe-2), so machine-readability is inconsistent/unconfirmed at the claimed path. Missing for 10: a genuine programmatic API (REST/SDK) beyond CLI invocation, and independent confirmation that the llms.txt/markdown docs endpoints actually work as documented.
